subject: Insurance
title: The Global Health Coverage Gap
description: One-minute skill: The Global Health Coverage Gap.

hook.text: 3.6 billion people—half the planet—lack essential health coverage. One illness can push an entire family into poverty.

buildup.text: In Sub-Saharan Africa, less than 5% of people have formal health insurance. Out-of-pocket costs bankrupt millions.

discovery.text: Community-based insurance pools risk among villagers.

twist.text: The WHO estimates that universal health coverage would cost just $371 billion more per year globally.

climax.text: The tools to provide universal coverage exist.

quiz.question: How many people globally lack essential health coverage?
